script:
local Player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Rooms = workspace:WaitForChild("CurrentRooms")

--// feel free to add your own stuff to the item list just: ClassName#Name (and remember to separate vai "," to separate each item)
local ItemList = "Model#KeyObtain, Model#LiveHintBook, Model#LeverForGate, Model#ChestBox, Model#LiveBreakerPolePickup, Model#FigureRig, Model#Snare"
local CheatingLightColor = Color3.new(0, 255, 0)
local LightDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back

local RbxCreate, tinsert, tclear, tostr = Instance.new, table.insert, table.clear, tostring
local ActiveHints = {}

local function CreateHint(Parent, HintType)
	if HintType == "Hint" then
		local Highlight = RbxCreate("Highlight", Parent)
		Highlight.FillTransparency = 1
		Highlight.OutlineColor = CheatingLightColor
		
		tinsert(ActiveHints, Highlight)
		
	elseif HintType == "Light" then
		local Bulb = RbxCreate("SpotLight", Parent)
		Bulb.Color = CheatingLightColor
		Bulb.Face = LightDirection
		Bulb.Brightness = 5
		
		tinsert(ActiveHints, Bulb)
	end
end

Player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CurrentRoom"):Connect(function()
	local RoomID = Player:GetAttribute("CurrentRoom")
	
	for _, hint in ActiveHints do
		if hint and hint.Parent then
			hint:Destroy()
		end
	end
	
	tclear(ActiveHints)
	
	local CurrentRoom = Rooms:FindFirstChild(tostr(RoomID))
	if not CurrentRoom then return end
	
	local Door = CurrentRoom:FindFirstChild("Door")
	if Door then
		CreateHint(Door.Door, "Light")
	end
	
	for _, Object in CurrentRoom:QueryDescendants(ItemList) do
		CreateHint(Object, "Hint")
	end
end)
